title: Torium Ad Astra
description: Torium Into Space with Ad Astra!
body:
Take Minecraft beyond the Overworld and begin your journey among the stars.

Torium: Ad Astra Edition is a space-focused Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge modpack built around the incredible Ad Astra experience. Construct rockets, establish planetary outposts, explore distant worlds, and build your own interplanetary civilization—all while benefiting from extensive performance optimizations and visual enhancements.

Whether you're launching your first rocket to the Moon or creating massive colonies across the solar system, this pack delivers a smooth and immersive space exploration experience.

### Explore New Worlds


Travel to new planets, moons, and dimensions, each featuring unique environments, resources, and challenges. Progress through advanced technology, fuel systems, oxygen management, and space-age machinery as you expand beyond Earth.

- Ad Astra
- Ad Extendra
- Star Wars Planets
- Planets+
- Perspatium
- Better Oil Deposits

Torium includes a collection of optimization mods to ensure smooth gameplay, faster loading times, and improved server performance.
